title: Brown spoke of biblical UFOs and aliens with his family
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Brown spoke of biblical UFOs and aliens with his family, about mid-20th century at Brown family home, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I also learned from Townsend Brown's daughter, Linda, that the inventor would constantly speak of biblical UFOs and aliens behind closed doors and with his family.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host who made a documentary about the American inventor Townsend Brown, says he learned something from Brown's daughter, Linda. According to her, Brown often talked about UFOs in the Bible and about aliens, at home and with his family, though not in public. If true, it would mean the inventor privately believed in visitors from elsewhere.
